title: Ratchet: How Reliable Must an LLM Judge Be to Retire a Skill?

rs.key_step: 固定模型的技能库按每技能有符号结果统计淘汰，并限制库容量；单独审计judge假阳性与假阴性。
rs.why_non_obvious: 总体pass率可能被router拒用掩盖；误把失败判成功会偏移淘汰统计均值，不能靠更多样本消除偏差。
rs.trigger_condition: When a noisy judge controls persistent-artifact retirement, audit its directional errors against the retirement threshold before using more samples.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When a noisy judge controls persistent-artifact retirement, audit its directional errors against the retirement threshold before using more samples.

signatures.object: 技能库按贡献淘汰的judge信号
signatures.information: router每次最多一个skill或none、逐次有符号成绩、失败模式与历史log
signatures.operation: 按最低证据数及负贡献阈值淘汰、容量上限、约束合成；把judge视二元误差通道
signatures.claimed_effect: 摘要声称失败判通过率≥(1−τ)/2会使淘汰失效，更多样本不能修复；核心证明未在缓存中。

evidence.quote: a judge scoring failures as passes at rate $(1-τ)/2$ or above retires nothing, at any sample size, for eviction margin $τ$.

signatures.failure_boundary: 缓存缺公式/§4–6，未验证界、默认参数或全部实验；关联贡献含router选择和存活偏差。

relevance.how: judge应按假阳性/假阴性及动作阈值审计，整体一致率不足。
